notes.title: Demo Update & Strange Site Change
notes.content:
Hello, and thank you for supporting TRACE: Definitive Edition! We have updated the demo build with new changes. After updating the demo, we recommend restarting the game to not encounter any bugs.

[h2]Changes include:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The story memento has been removed from the build. Don't worry, it'll come back! We're just trying to find a better way to have them flow within the gameplay.
[*] There is a new camera to use that is much larger for photos! You can also now draw on the photo directly without being taken out of the game
[*] All audio now mutes when pressing "Mute all sounds"
[/list]

Thank you again for playing the demo and wishlisting TRACE: Definitive Edition! We greatly appreciate all your support.

Now if you'll excuse us, something strange has appeared on the CMG site that we must investigate...

- Coolmath Games & STUDIO LOOK

notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo of TRACE: Definitive Edition! We are happy to announce that the demo has been updated with some bugs fixed including:

[list]
[*] Parallax toggle has been fixed to not be undone after an animation plays
[*] Music during the cutscene plays at normal speed
[*] The paper must be obtained [i]after[/i] opening up the grey box
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game - we're excited to share more updates as we continue the development process! 

- Coolmath Games & STUDIO LOOK
